item.title: Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan Guide: Whale Sharks & the Pacific Tank
item.description: The Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan is one of the largest and most acclaimed aquariums in the world, built around a single breathtaking idea: a colossal central tank representing the Pacific Ocean, nine metres deep, home to whale sharks — the largest fish on Earth — gliding past as you spiral down around it. Rather than a series of separate rooms, Kaiyukan takes you on a journey through the habitats of the Pacific Rim, from rainforest to Antarctic to the open sea.

item.title: Osaka Bay Guide: Kaiyukan, the Ferris Wheel & Sakurajima
item.description: West of the city centre, Osaka Bay opens the metropolis to the sea — a breezy waterfront of attractions, harbour views, and big-sky sunsets that makes a refreshing change from the neon canyons of Minami. Here you’ll find the giant Tempozan Ferris wheel, the superb Kaiyukan aquarium, sightseeing cruises, and, across the water on Sakurajima, Universal Studios Japan. It’s family territory and a great spot to watch the sun sink over the harbour.
